class Point:
    def __init__(self, *coords):
        self.coords = list(coords)

    def get_length_squared(self):
        return sum(c * c for c in self.coords)

    def dot(self, other):
        return sum(self.coords[i] * other.coords[i] for i in range(len(self.coords)))

    def subtract(self, other):
        new_coords = [self.coords[i] - other.coords[i] for i in range(len(self.coords))]
        return Point(*new_coords)

def is_valid(pts, index):
    p = pts[index]
    size = len(pts)
    for j in range(size):
        if j == index:
            continue
        for k in range(size):
            if k == index or k == j:
                continue
            x = pts[j].subtract(p)
            y = pts[k].subtract(p)
            if x.dot(y) > 0:
                return False
    return True

def main():
    n = int(input().strip())
    if n > 11:
        print(0)
        return
    points = []
    for _ in range(n):
        parts = input().split()
        coords = [int(parts[j]) for j in range(5)]
        points.append(Point(*coords))
    valid_points = []
    for i in range(n):
        if is_valid(points, i):
            valid_points.append(i + 1)
    print(len(valid_points))
    for v in valid_points:
        print(v)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
